title: No validation of IPv6 address semantics in LOADng messages
description:
Location: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs lines 376-382, 443-449, 520-523

Issue: The from_bytes methods accept any 16 bytes as IPv6 addresses without validating semantic validity. Unspecified (::), loopback (::1), and multicast addresses are accepted without rejection.

Attack vectors:
- RREQ with originator=:: wastes network resources on unanswerable queries
- RERR with unreachable=:: could trigger deletion of default route
- RREP with crafted addresses could poison routing tables

Suggested fix: Add address validation or document that callers must validate. Consider rejecting unspecified/loopback/multicast at parse time for security-critical address fields.
